text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear multi-paragraph argument with intro, reasons, counterclaim, conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how well the essay structures ideas into a coherent progression with distinct sections and a visible line of reasoning."},{"evidence":"“The first reason… The second… Although…”","quality":"transitions","description":"This captures the use of connective language that helps guide the reader through claims, counterarguments, and conclusions."},{"evidence":"“I disagree… because…” and “if we were to hypothetically…”","quality":"argumentative control","description":"This captures a stronger ability to present a position, support it with reasons, and address an opposing view."},{"evidence":"“year-round school years,” “retain information,” “mentally”","quality":"academic diction","description":"This captures more precise and formal word choice suited to explanatory and persuasive writing."},{"evidence":"“mandatory (but simple) assignments from the previous year”","quality":"solution development","description":"This captures the ability to move beyond complaint and propose a concrete remedy to the problem being discussed."}]}
